changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Create audit table for partial write-off transactions
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS m_partial_writeoff_audit ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL, loan_id BIGINT NOT NULL, loan_transaction_id BIGINT NOT NULL, transaction_date date NOT NULL, principal_portion DECIMAL(19, 6) NULL, interest_portion DECIMAL(19, 6) NULL, fee_charges_portion DECIMAL(19, 6) NULL, penalty_charges_portion DECIMAL(19, 6) NULL, total_amount DECIMAL(19, 6) NOT NULL, loan_balance_before DECIMAL(19, 6) NOT NULL, loan_balance_after DECIMAL(19, 6) NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, initiated_by BIGINT NOT NULL, initiated_on timestamp NOT NULL, approved_by BIGINT NULL, approved_on timestamp NULL, office_id BIGINT NOT NULL, note VARCHAR(1000) NULL, external_id VARCHAR(100) NULL, created_on_utc timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, last_modified_on_utc timestamp NULL, created_by BIGINT NULL, last_modified_by BIGINT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_M_PARTIAL_WRITEOFF_AUDIT PRIMARY KEY (id) )

changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Add foreign key constraints to audit table
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE m_partial_writeoff_audit ADD CONSTRAINT fk_partial_writeoff_audit_loan FOREIGN KEY (loan_id) REFERENCES m_loan(id), ADD CONSTRAINT fk_partial_writeoff_audit_loan_transaction FOREIGN KEY (loan_transaction_id) REFERENCES m_loan_transaction(id), ADD CONSTRAINT fk_partial_writeoff_audit_initiated_by FOREIGN KEY (initiated_by) REFERENCES m_appuser(id), ADD CONSTRAINT fk_partial_writeoff_audit_approved_by FOREIGN KEY (approved_by) REFERENCES m_appuser(id), ADD CONSTRAINT fk_partial_writeoff_audit_office FOREIGN KEY (office_id) REFERENCES m_office(id)

changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Add unique constraint on external_id for partial write-off audit
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE m_partial_writeoff_audit ADD CONSTRAINT unique_partial_writeoff_audit_external_id UNIQUE (external_id)
